0.EN:
There is an all-knowing woman here...
She knows everything, both in the past and future,
except the range of her knowledge is limited to video games.

1.EN:
(Sounds like someone with similar tastes to Favna.
I wonder what she's like?)

2.EN:
Welcome, Favna-sama!
"Necrocalibur the Unholy" is in stock right now!

3.EN: What wonderful news. I shall tell my grandfather at once!

4.EN:
While I'm here, I should ask if you have "Glory of Heracles 4" in stock.
My grandfather is also searching for "Fist God Dragon Fight"...

5.EN: As always, your grandfather has such heroic tastes!

6.EN:
You watch as Favna and the shopkeeper have
a lively conversation about retro games...

7.EN:
(Something that can make new dishes we couldn't
and that would be useful for the cafe...)

9.EN:
Are you looking for a present for a lady?
Here's a catalog of recommended items.

10.EN: (A bread machine! I'll go with this!)

11.EN:
(I'll give it to Miyu next time we meet.
I hope she likes it...)

12.EN:
The newest video game consoles are on display,
including the OLED model that just got released.

13.EN:
"It's the newest Denmon game.
Have you played it yet, Favna?"

14.EN:
Yes, of course.
Rin is playing Garnet, and I'm playing Amethyst.

15.EN: Even these games will be called "retro" after many years have passed...

16.EN:
But I believe they will be passed down as legendary games
that are just as good as their predecessors.
